checks.name: archive_order
checks.code:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from logging_store import append_log
with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d)/'app.log'
 for text in ['one','two','three']: append_log(p,text,5,2)
 assert p.read_text()=='three\n' and (Path(d)/'app.log.1').read_text()=='two\n' and (Path(d)/'app.log.2').read_text()=='one\n'

checks.name: bounded_archive_count
checks.code:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from logging_store import append_log
with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d)/'x'
 for n in range(6): append_log(p,str(n),2,2)
 assert sorted(x.name for x in Path(d).iterdir())==['x','x.1','x.2'] and p.read_text()=='5\n' and (Path(d)/'x.2').read_text()=='3\n'
